name: Neozone – Schema for YouTube Video
author: Alexandre Bonazzi

sections.description:
This plugin automatically detects:
– youtube.com/watch links
– youtu.be links
– Shorts videos

It then generates Schema.org VideoObject markup compatible with Google Discover and rich results.

For more detailed instructions, please see our setup guide on neozone.org.

No configuration required.

Support

For questions or assistance:
https://www.neozone.org/contacts/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ folder
  2. Activate it from the Extensions menu
  3. Add a YouTube link to an article
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First public version
  • Support for Shorts videos
  • Automatic generation of VideoObject schema

short_description: Automatically generates a VideoObject schema as soon as a YouTube link is detected in an article.
